text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Trainer, dost thou know of such a proverb?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "‘No Aoba can surpass Satsuki!’"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: In other words, this is how it is.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume who couldn't run in the Satsuki Sho
won't suddenly burst into bloom
in the Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In other words, "the new forces are nothing to fear."
That is what it means.
choice_data_list: Oh, I think I've heard about that before...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In fact, no Umamusume who advanced from the GII Aoba Sho—the trial race for the Nippon Derby—has ever won the main event.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it plays out like usual years,
we wouldn't need to fear the Aoba Sho runners, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it applies to me, too...
Um—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: To Lady Symboli Kris S as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Symboli Kris S. She's running in the Nippon Derby, a rapidly rising star right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite bearing the Symboli name, she hails from overseas
rather than Japan. That alone makes her...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: There is an eerie uncertainty about what she might do next...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She seems like a consummate professional who always fulfills her mission. The fact that she's stepping up means...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They are definitely aiming for us.
And the reason it feels even more ominous is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They were saying that No Reason's path
to the Classic Triple Crown would be fraught with difficulties... or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, things were terrible back during the Satsuki Sho, too.
All that chaos from an unexpected registration error...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the second leg, the "Nippon Derby,"
there is a chance that Symboli Kris S's presence could be a disaster...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Prrrr, prrrr...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up, Trainer?
Is that an arrow letter from someone?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A message arrived on my smartphone. It seems to be from home, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was surprised. What was written there—
apparently, there was major news near my family home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Word is that a legendary portable shrine, one that hasn't seen the light of day for decades, will be carried through the festival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A lucky charm I've admired for ages. If I head home now
and help carry it, one of my dreams will come true, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a priceless mikoshi! Carrying such a relic
would surely make one feel on top of the world!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I cannot simply ignore this!
Even if I must abandon the Japan Derby,
I must go at once!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem* Well, indeed.
While it is truly a shame not to experience
feeling as triumphant as a rising dragon...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: If I head back home now, I won't make it in time for the all-important Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
So, what will you do, Trainer?
—Let me hear your answer.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Will you choose a future with me, or your other dream?! Which shall it be?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My trainee Umamusume, of course!
...is what I'd like to say, but for some reason...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel an... irresistible power...
Which one should I choose—the ultimate dilemma!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Trainer!
Indeed, indeed!
I had full faith in thee~.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is not a portable shrine thou shalt carry, but me!
Let us laugh together at the Japan Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...That was a close call, but I managed to hold on.
Still, there's just way too much happening all at once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That means I must focus all the more intently.
On the decisive showdown that divides the realm—the Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Aargh, off with their heads! Off with their heads! Cut them down, cut them down!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splaaash!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the days between No Reason and me
came to an abrupt end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without even witnessing the Japan Derby,
and never returning to Tracen Academy again...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Wait, cut that kind of joking out!
You're coming? With me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...That was a close call, but I managed to hold on.
Still, there's just way too much happening all at once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That means I must focus all the more intently.
On the decisive showdown that divides the realm—the Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No Reason. This is Symboli Kris S.
Pleased... to work with you.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, likewise!
Well, let's keep things harmonious and fun!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm, so she hasn't let her guard down.
Quite cautious indeed...
And this presence...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(She's a bit different from a master swordsman.
Right, if I had to make a comparison—)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: (An Umamusume who doesn't 'slash' with the flow, but locks onto a single target and 'shoots'...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: (Like a muskeeter, are we...?)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(And even more than Lord Kris S,
the one we cannot underestimate is...)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Has your encounter concluded?
General of the East, and the Jet-Black Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Now, I have... finished walking my path of thorns
and finally arrived at this place of rest."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Having obtained sacrifices from both East and West,
I have—finally—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Culminating in myself!
The completion of the MC rotation!!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, she's grown even more confident.
And entirely deservedly so...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"She really did fight her way through the NHK Mile Cup
to make it here, after all.
Even so, however—!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: A three-way deadlock—I will not yield.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer and I have crossed countless precipices too.
Let us duel fair and square, Demon King of the Sixth Heaven!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fuhahaha!
Come at me, warlord of the East!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Live on, and become a part of me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both are wildly unconventional, doing things entirely their own way.
Unrestrained, fierce heroes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Toward defeating the Silent Clan.
Who will be the one to claim the top banner of this generation?"
